# Vendored UCP JSON Schemas

The schemas under each release folder are the Universal Commerce Protocol JSON Schemas as
published at `https://ucp.dev/<release>/schemas/` (and, for 2026-04-08, the discovery profile
schema from the release source tree), copied unchanged. They are third-party material licensed
under the Apache License 2.0; a copy of that licence is in
[`LICENSES/Apache-2.0.txt`](../../../LICENSES/Apache-2.0.txt). The repository's Orchestrum Personal Use
License does not apply to them.
